title: Reproduction package: subset-decomposed grounding effects in NL2GeoSQL on CQ-125
description: Public reproduction repository for the associated manuscript on subset-decomposed schema-aware grounding effects in PostGIS NL2SQL. Contains: (1) the 125-question Chongqing PostGIS benchmark CQ-125, (2) frozen LLM execution outputs for 11 model families (gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview, gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-3.5-flash, deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek-v4-pro, qwen3.6-flash, qwen3.6-plus, qwen3.7-max, gemma-4-31b-it) at N=3 samples each, baseline (no grounding) and full (grounding) modes, (3) the offline analysis scripts that reduce the JSONL to the paper tables, and (4) the prompt profiles used. CI-style checks verify that the analysis pipeline reproduces the reported values.
